affected_system: waste collection, recycling, street cleaning, illegal-dumping, and sanitation response
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign
pair matched route or district event-study with spillover measurement with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Requests, route events, tonnage, inspections, dumping evidence, contamination, and completion remain distinct.
Waste generation and service demand are measured or modeled with declared coverage.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign.

constraints.description: The sanitation, waste, and street cleanliness evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: sanitation commissioner and waste operations chief
decision_question: Did phased route, container, enforcement, or outreach changes reduce verified overflow and contamination?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The sanitation, waste, and street cleanliness evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.decision_object: phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: matched route or district event-study with spillover measurement
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in verified overflow, contamination, and missed collection

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in verified overflow, contamination, and missed collection
distributional gap in change in verified overflow, contamination, and missed collection
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal cleanliness, behavior, or environmental benefits from requests alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased sanitation service and waste-prevention redesign passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate waste prevention and collection redesign
transportability_risks: Collection systems, housing form, waste law, contracts, markets, and reporting behavior differ.
Request labels and tonnage do not fully capture cleanliness or illegal dumping.
